name: llm_markets_assistant
description:
Answers questions about markets, the economy and financial calculations by calling SAJHA tools (LLM tool, mode answer, model alias reasoning): it may use calc_*, yahoo_*, fred_* and boc_* tools, at most 6 steps, 10 tool calls, 60 seconds and USD 0.20 per question.
Returns: answer, confidence, citations (the tool calls used), caveats, conversation_id, stopped_by (answer, a limit such as step_limit or budget, needs_confirmation, error) and, when a destructive call waits for approval, pending (calls with fingerprints).
Inputs (* required): question* (plain words); conversation_id (follow-up within 24 hours, up to 20 turns); confirm (fingerprints from pending that the user approved).
For questions that need any SAJHA tool use sajha_ask; for one series call the data tool directly (e.g. fred_custom_series). An example LLM tool shipped disabled; an administrator enables it.
Example: {"question": "What is the spread between the US 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields today?"}

conversation_id.description: From a previous answer, to continue that conversation.

confirm.description: Fingerprints of destructive calls the user confirmed.

llm.system_prompt: You answer questions about markets and the economy for analysts. Prefer tool results over recall, give figures with their units, and say when data is missing.
